data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $246.086m. Using the gross claims development table the report shows a net adverse prior-year reserve movement of approximately $31.226m (around 12.7% of opening gross claims), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The movement appears driven largely by natural catastrophe and large-loss development on earlier underwriting years (notably losses arising in years cited such as 2014 and 2016 in the development table) and is consistent with the report's commentary referencing Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and other 2017 catastrophe events.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2017 underwriting year was significantly affected by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the two Mexican earthquakes and the California wildfires.
There were losses from our closed years (2009-2015), and these years produced a decifit of US$5.4 million which contributed to both the calendar year result and the closing 2016 year result.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) table (note 18) as no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' gross amount was provided. The report also contains a verbatim sentence quoting a prior accident year 'adverse development of claims incurred of $5.1 million' - that phrase refers to claims incurred (net presentation in narrative) and was captured verbatim in exact_reserve_text but is not the gross reserve movement. The triangle values are presented in $'000s in the report and were converted to millions for the fields above. There is a difference between the gross PY movement derived from the triangle (+$31.226m) and the gross change-in-claims-outstanding line for the year (which shows gross change in claims outstanding of $16.299m including current-year movement and FX effects); the triangle-derived PYD is the adopted primary figure per the extraction rules.
